name: Montana

context: MT 327: Montana NRCS supplies a WEPS template for Conservation Cover, with biomass set by a 0.75 adjustment factor across the state.
cover_rules: MT 340: Time the cover crop so soil is protected during the critical erosion periods.
MT 340: Aim for at least 90-percent combined canopy and surface residue cover during periods of potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
MT 340: Do not mechanically harvest cover crop biomass; leave residues on the surface after termination.
residue: MT 329: No-till keeps at least 2,000 pounds per acre (small grain equivalents) of residue and a crop stubble height of at least 10 inches throughout the year.
MT 345: Reduced till keeps at least 60 percent surface residue cover throughout the year.
MT 329: STIR value no greater than 20 for no-till; MT 345: STIR no greater than 80 for reduced till.
barriers: MT 589: Trap strips are at least 15 feet wide where stubble is 1 foot or more in height, and at least 25 feet where it is under 1 foot.
MT 603: Herbaceous wind barriers need a minimum expected height of 1.5 feet and porosity of 40 to 50 percent; spacing must not exceed 10 times barrier height.
windbreak: MT 380: Between-row spacing is 15-24 feet; within-row spacing is 3-6 feet for shrubs under 10 feet, 6-10 feet for 10-25 feet, 10-15 feet for trees over 25 feet.
grazing: MT 528: On native rangeland, planned growing-season use of key forage species will not exceed 50% of the current year's growth in key areas.
MT 528: On native rangeland, dormant season utilization of key herbaceous forage species will not exceed 65% in key areas.
MT 528: During the growing season, grazing duration will not exceed 45 days.
seeding: MT 550: Calculate seeding rates on a PLS basis; seedings within 10 percent of the planned rate are acceptable.
MT 342: Critical area plantings are seeded at 2x the full-stand rate, broadcast seeding at 4x.
MT 550: Nurse crops are not recommended on dryland with under 16 inches annual precipitation; spring wheat, barley or oats at 10 lbs./acre where used.
dont_seed: MT 342: Do not use nurse crops on critical area plantings; seed a cover crop one season before instead.
MT 550: Warm season species are not generally recommended for dormant fall seeding, except switchgrass.
MT 342: Do not sod dryland sites receiving less than 18 inches of precipitation unless irrigated.
disturbed: MT 342: Use temporary cover crops for up to two years where cover is needed to stabilize disturbed sites.
dunes: MT 342: Plants for sand dunes must survive burial by blowing sand and sand blasting; include sand fences or brush matting where applicable.

seedWin.text: MT 550: Spring seedings are completed by May 15.
MT 550: Dormant fall seedings after October 15 or once soil at 2 inches stays at 40 F or less for ten days; seed before soil freezes.
MT 550: Seedings after May 15 only with two feet of moist soil, finished by August 1.
